sources.title: GLM-5.3-Flash | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: GLM-5.3-Flash, also known as ox-alpha, is Z.ai's new 320B parameter multimodal open model with 18B active parameters. GLM-5.3-Flash outperforms GLM-5.2 across benchmarks and real-world workloads at one-tenth the price, while approaching Claude Opus 4.8 on coding and agentic benchmarks.

sources.title: LibertAIDAI/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: NVFP4 quantization of zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash — Z.ai's 320B / 18B-active natively-multimodal MoE, the first GLM to combine sparse and linear attention — for serving on vLLM. This is a weight-only NVFP4 (NVFP4-A16) checkpoint.

sources.title: zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash | vLLM Recipes - recipes.vllm.ai
sources.snippet: GLM-5.3-Flash is a 320B-total / 18B-active multimodal MoE with hybrid KDA and sparse MLA attention, native FP8 weights, MTP, and a 1M-token context window.

sources.title: How to Use GLM-5.3-Flash: Complete Guide to the Ox Alpha Model Zhipu ...
sources.snippet: Zhipu's Ox Alpha stealth model is GLM-5.3-Flash: 320B-A18B, natively multimodal, 1M context, MIT license. Full official benchmarks vs Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.6 Terra, plus pricing and API setup.

sources.title: Is Ox Alpha GLM-5.3 Flash? Evidence and Gaps - kingy.ai
sources.snippet: And, as of the source cutoff, Z.ai's official model and pricing pages contain no model called GLM-5.3 Flash. The defensible verdict is narrower: Ox Alpha is likely a GLM-5.x-family model and plausibly an unreleased multimodal or efficiency-focused derivative of GLM-5.3.
